verses.tsw_comparator: I will save you from all your uncleannesses. I will call for the grain and make it plentiful, and I will not bring famine upon you.

verses.rationale: Keeps two forms of produce and social disgrace.
verses.before: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you will no longer bear the reproach of famine among the nations.
verses.after: I will increase the fruit of the trees and the produce of the field, so you will no longer bear the disgrace of famine among the nations.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you will no longer bear the reproach of famine among the nations.

verses.rationale: Preserves remorse after restoration, not before.
verses.before: Then you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves because of your iniquities and your abominations.
verses.after: Then you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good. You will loathe yourselves for your guilt and your abominations.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves because of your iniquities and your abominations.

verses.rationale: Retains repeated motive and sharp imperatives.
verses.before: It is not for your sake that I am acting, declares the LORD GOD; let this be known to you. Be ashamed and humiliated because of your ways, house of Israel.
verses.after: I am not doing this for your sake, declares the Lord GOD. Know that! Be ashamed and disgraced for your ways, house of Israel.
verses.tsw_comparator: It is not for your sake that I am acting, declares the LORD GOD; let this be known to you. Be ashamed and humiliated because of your ways, house of Israel.

verses.rationale: Connects cleansing with restored settlement.
verses.before: Thus says the LORD GOD: On the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
verses.after: “This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I cleanse you from all your guilt, I will make the cities inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.
verses.tsw_comparator: Thus says the LORD GOD: On the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

verses.rationale: Keeps public visibility of reversal.
verses.before: The desolate land will be cultivated, instead of lying desolate before the eyes of everyone who passes by.
verses.after: The desolate land will be tilled instead of lying waste before everyone who passes by.
verses.tsw_comparator: The desolate land will be cultivated, instead of lying desolate before the eyes of everyone who passes by.

verses.rationale: Retains Eden comparison and three ruin descriptors.
verses.before: They will say, “This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden; and the ruined, desolate, and demolished cities are fortified and inhabited.”
verses.after: They will say, ‘This desolate land has become like the garden of Eden. The ruined, desolate, demolished cities are fortified and inhabited.’
verses.tsw_comparator: They will say, “This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden; and the ruined, desolate, and demolished cities are fortified and inhabited.”

verses.rationale: Preserves both divine names and building/planting pair.
verses.before: Then the nations that remain around you will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt what was demolished and planted what was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.
verses.after: Then the nations left around you will know that I, the LORD, rebuilt the demolished places and planted what was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the nations that remain around you will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt what was demolished and planted what was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.

verses.rationale: Keeps permitted inquiry and human-flock image.
verses.before: Thus says the LORD GOD: I will also allow the house of Israel to seek me for this: to do it for them. I will multiply them like a flock of people.
verses.after: “This is what the Lord GOD says: I will also let the house of Israel ask me to do this for them: I will multiply their people like a flock.
verses.tsw_comparator: Thus says the LORD GOD: I will also allow the house of Israel to seek me for this: to do it for them. I will multiply them like a flock of people.

verses.rationale: Preserves sacrificial comparison without adding deaths of people.
verses.before: Like a holy flock, like the flock of Jerusalem at its appointed festivals, so the ruined cities will be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
verses.after: Like flocks for holy offerings, like Jerusalem’s flocks at her festivals, the ruined cities will be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Like a holy flock, like the flock of Jerusalem at its appointed festivals, so the ruined cities will be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.rationale: Keeps both divine names and spirit-mediated vision.
verses.before: The LORD’s hand was upon me, and the LORD brought me out by the Spirit of the LORD and set me down in the middle of the valley; it was full of bones.
verses.after: The hand of the LORD came upon me. He brought me out by the spirit of the LORD and set me down in the middle of a valley full of bones.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD’s hand was upon me, and the LORD brought me out by the Spirit of the LORD and set me down in the middle of the valley; it was full of bones.

verses.rationale: Preserves doubled intensity and circling inspection.
verses.before: The LORD led me around among them; and look—there were very many on the surface of the valley, and look—they were very dry.
verses.after: He led me all around them. There were very many bones across the valley, and they were very dry.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD led me around among them; and look—there were very many on the surface of the valley, and look—they were very dry.

verses.rationale: Keeps question and restrained answer.
verses.before: And the LORD said to me, “Mortal, can these bones live?” And I said, “Lord GOD, you know.”
verses.after: He asked me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord GOD, you know.”
verses.tsw_comparator: And the LORD said to me, “Mortal, can these bones live?” And I said, “Lord GOD, you know.”

verses.rationale: Retains direct address to bones.
verses.before: Then the LORD said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and say to them: Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.after: Then he told me, “Prophesy over these bones. Say to them, ‘Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the LORD said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and say to them: Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.

verses.rationale: Uses breath contextually while noting shared spirit word.
verses.before: Thus says the LORD GOD to these bones: Look—I am about to bring breath into you, and you will live.
verses.after: This is what the Lord GOD says to these bones: I am bringing breath into you, and you will live.
verses.tsw_comparator: Thus says the LORD GOD to these bones: Look—I am about to bring breath into you, and you shall live.

verses.rationale: Preserves bodily sequence before life and recognition.
verses.before: I will set sinews upon you, and will bring flesh upon you, and will cover you with skin, and will put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
verses.after: I will put sinews on you, bring flesh upon you, cover you with skin, and put breath into you. You will live, and you will know that I am the LORD.’”
verses.tsw_comparator: And I will set sinews upon you, and will bring flesh upon you, and will cover you with skin, and will put breath in you, and you shall live. Then you shall know that I am the LORD.”

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated prophesying and matching bones.
verses.before: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I prophesied, there was a sound, and look—a rattling; and the bones came together, bone to its bone.
verses.after: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a sound—a rattling—and the bones came together, bone to its bone.
verses.tsw_comparator: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I prophesied, there was a sound, and look—a rattling; and the bones came together, bone to its bone.

verses.rationale: Preserves incompleteness after bodily restoration.
verses.before: I looked, and look—sinews were on them, and flesh had come upon them, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
verses.after: I looked: sinews were on them, flesh had grown, and skin covered them. But there was no breath in them.
verses.tsw_comparator: And I looked, and look—sinews were on them, and flesh had come upon them, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

verses.rationale: Keeps breath/winds wordplay and violent death.
verses.before: Then the LORD said to me, “Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, mortal, and say to the breath: Thus says the LORD GOD: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.”
verses.after: He told me, “Prophesy to the breath. Prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath: This is what the Lord GOD says: Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe into these slain, so they may live.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the LORD said to me, “Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, mortal, and say to the breath: Thus says the LORD GOD: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.”

verses.rationale: Preserves three stages and collective strength.
verses.before: So I prophesied as the LORD commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived and stood on their feet—an exceedingly great army.
verses.after: I prophesied as he commanded me. Breath entered them; they lived and stood on their feet, an immense army.
verses.tsw_comparator: So I prophesied as the LORD commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived and stood on their feet—an exceedingly great army.

verses.rationale: Retains explicit identification and people's threefold lament.
verses.before: Then the LORD said to me, “Mortal, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Look—they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost; we are cut off.’
verses.after: He told me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. They say, ‘Our bones have dried up, our hope is lost, and we are cut off.’
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the LORD said to me, “Mortal, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Look—they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost; we are cut off.’

verses.rationale: Keeps grave image even as explanation names return.
verses.before: So prophesy, and say to them: Thus says the LORD GOD: Look—I am about to open your graves, and bring you up from your graves, O my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
verses.after: Therefore prophesy and tell them: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am opening your graves and bringing you up from them, my people. I will bring you to Israel’s soil.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore prophesy, and say to them: Thus says the LORD GOD: Look—I am about to open your graves, and bring you up from your graves, O my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

verses.rationale: Retains repetition and my people address.
verses.before: And you will know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and bring you up from your graves, O my people.
verses.after: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and bring you up from them, my people.
verses.tsw_comparator: And you shall know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and bring you up from your graves, O my people.

verses.rationale: Keeps spirit distinct in context and repeated divine name.
verses.before: I will put my Spirit within you, and you will live; and I will set you upon your own soil. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken, and I have done it, says the LORD.”
verses.after: I will put my spirit within you, and you will live. I will settle you on your own soil. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken and done it, declares the LORD.”
verses.tsw_comparator: And I will put my Spirit within you, and you shall live; and I will set you upon your own soil. Then you shall know that I, the LORD, have spoken, and I have done it, says the LORD.”

verses.rationale: Marks new enacted sign.
verses.before: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.after: The word of the LORD came to me:
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.rationale: Preserves full inscriptions and read-form companions.
verses.before: “And you, mortal, take for yourself one stick and write upon it, ‘For Judah and for the sons of Israel joined with him.’ Then take another stick and write upon it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the house of Israel joined with him.’
verses.after: “Son of man, take a stick and write on it, ‘For Judah and the Israelites joined to him.’ Then take another stick and write on it, ‘For Joseph—the stick of Ephraim—and all the house of Israel joined to him.’
verses.tsw_comparator: “And you, mortal, take for yourself one stick and write upon it, ‘For Judah and for the sons of Israel joined with him.’ Then take another stick and write upon it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the house of Israel joined with him.’

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated oneness and visible hand.
verses.before: Bring them near, one to the other, into one stick, so that they become one in your hand.
verses.after: Bring them together into one stick, so they become one in your hand.
verses.tsw_comparator: Bring them near, one to the other, into one stick, so that they become one in your hand.

verses.rationale: Retains question introducing interpretation.
verses.before: And when the sons of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Will you not tell us what these mean to you?’
verses.after: When your people ask, ‘Will you not tell us what these mean?’
verses.tsw_comparator: And when the sons of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Will you not tell us what these mean to you?’

verses.rationale: Preserves Joseph/Ephraim relation and divine hand.
verses.before: speak to them: Thus says the LORD GOD: Look, I am taking the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel joined with him, and I will put them upon the stick of Judah and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.
verses.after: tell them: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am taking Joseph’s stick, which is in Ephraim’s hand, and the tribes of Israel joined to him. I will join them to Judah’s stick and make them one stick. They will be one in my hand.
verses.tsw_comparator: speak to them: Thus says the LORD GOD: Look, I am taking the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel joined with him, and I will put them upon the stick of Judah and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

verses.rationale: Keeps visible instruction.
verses.before: The sticks upon which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.
verses.after: Hold the sticks you have written on before their eyes.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sticks upon which you write shall be in your hand before their eyes.

verses.rationale: Preserves gathering and return sequence.
verses.before: Then speak to them: Thus says the LORD GOD: Look, I am taking the sons of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and I will gather them from all around and bring them to their own land.
verses.after: Tell them: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am taking the Israelites from the nations where they have gone. I will gather them from all around and bring them to their own soil.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then speak to them: Thus says the LORD GOD: Look, I am taking the sons of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and I will gather them from all around and bring them to their own land.

verses.rationale: Retains one/two contrast and repeated negation.
verses.before: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel, and one king will be king over all of them. They will no longer be two nations, and they will no longer be divided into two kingdoms.
verses.after: I will make them one nation in the land, on Israel’s mountains. One king will rule them all. They will no longer be two nations, never again divided into two kingdoms.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel, and one king shall be king over all of them. They shall no longer be two nations, and they shall no longer be divided into two kingdoms.

verses.rationale: Keeps pinned dwellings rather than emending to backslidings.
verses.before: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols, their detestable things, or any of their transgressions. I will save them from all their dwelling places in which they sinned, and I will cleanse them. Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.after: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols, detestable things, or any of their rebellions. I will save them from all the places where they have lived and sinned, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.tsw_comparator: They shall no longer defile themselves with their idols, their detestable things, or any of their transgressions. I will save them from all their dwelling places in which they sinned, and I will cleanse them. Then they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.rationale: Preserves David, one shepherd and conduct.
verses.before: My servant David will be king over them, and one shepherd will be for all of them. They will walk in my judgments and keep my statutes and do them.
verses.after: My servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd. They will follow my judgments, keep my statutes, and carry them out.
verses.tsw_comparator: My servant David shall be king over them, and one shepherd shall be for all of them. They shall walk in my judgments and keep my statutes and do them.

verses.rationale: Keeps three generations and repeated forever.
verses.before: They will live upon the land that I gave to my servant Jacob, where your fathers lived. They will live upon it, they and their children and their children’s children, forever, and David my servant will be their prince forever.
verses.after: They will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, where your ancestors lived. They, their children, and their children’s children will live there forever, and my servant David will be their prince forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: They shall live upon the land that I gave to my servant Jacob, where your fathers lived. They shall live upon it, they and their children and their children’s children, forever, and David my servant shall be their prince forever.

verses.rationale: Preserves covenant repetition and permanent sanctuary.
verses.before: I will cut a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will set them and multiply them and set my sanctuary in their midst forever.
verses.after: I will make a covenant of peace with them, an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and make them numerous, and I will put my sanctuary among them forever.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will cut a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them. I will set them and multiply them and set my sanctuary in their midst forever.

verses.rationale: Keeps over-them spatial wording with alternative noted.
verses.before: My dwelling place will be with them, and I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.after: My dwelling will be over them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.tsw_comparator: My dwelling place shall be with them, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

verses.rationale: Retains sanctifying agent and public recognition.
verses.before: Then the nations will know that I am the LORD who consecrates Israel, when my sanctuary is in their midst forever.”
verses.after: Then the nations will know that I, the LORD, make Israel holy, when my sanctuary is among them forever.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the nations shall know that I am the LORD who consecrates Israel, when my sanctuary is in their midst forever.”

verses.rationale: Marks Gog oracle.
verses.before: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
verses.after: The word of the LORD came to me:
verses.tsw_comparator: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:

verses.rationale: Reads rosh as chief; proper-name alternative noted.
verses.before: “Mortal, set your face against Gog, of the land of Magog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him.
verses.after: “Son of man, turn your face toward Gog of the land of Magog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. Prophesy against him.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Mortal, set your face against Gog, of the land of Magog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him.

verses.rationale: Preserves full repeated address.
verses.before: Say: ‘Thus says the LORD GOD: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
verses.after: Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
verses.tsw_comparator: Say: ‘Thus says the LORD GOD: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine compulsion and full military inventory.
verses.before: I will turn you about and put hooks in your jaws, and I will bring you out with all your army—horses and riders, all of them clothed in full armor, a great assembly with shield and buckler, all of them grasping swords.
verses.after: I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws, and bring you out with your whole army—horses and horsemen, all splendidly equipped, a great assembly with large and small shields, all wielding swords.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will turn you about and put hooks in your jaws, and I will bring you out with all your army—horses and riders, all of them clothed in full armor, a great assembly with shield and buckler, all of them grasping swords.

verses.rationale: Keeps ancient names without modern identification.
verses.before: Persia, Cush, and Put are with them, all of them with shield and helmet;
verses.after: Persia, Cush, and Put are with them, all with shield and helmet;
verses.tsw_comparator: Persia, Cush, and Put are with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

verses.rationale: Retains troop repetition and northern location.
verses.before: Gomer with all its troops; the house of Togarmah from the farthest parts of the north, with all its troops—many peoples are with you.
verses.after: Gomer with all its troops, Beth-togarmah from the far north with all its troops—many peoples are with you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Gomer with all its troops; the house of Togarmah from the farthest parts of the north, with all its troops—many peoples are with you.

verses.rationale: Preserves doubled preparation and guard command.
verses.before: Be ready; prepare yourself, you and all your assembly gathered around you, and be a guard for them.
verses.after: “Get ready! Prepare yourself, you and all the companies gathered around you. Be their guard.
verses.tsw_comparator: Be ready; prepare yourself, you and all your assembly gathered around you, and be a guard for them.

verses.rationale: Keeps temporal distance, recovery and repeated gathering.
verses.before: After many days you will be summoned. In the latter years you will come into a land restored from the sword, whose people have been gathered from many peoples upon the mountains of Israel, which had continually been a waste. It has been brought out from the peoples, and all of them live securely.
verses.after: After many days you will be summoned. In later years you will enter a land recovered from the sword, its people gathered from many peoples onto Israel’s mountains, which had long been desolate. They were brought out from the peoples, and all now live securely.
verses.tsw_comparator: After many days you will be summoned. In the latter years you will come into a land restored from the sword, whose people have been gathered from many peoples upon the mountains of Israel, which had continually been a waste. It has been brought out from the peoples, and all of them live securely.

verses.rationale: Retains two similes and full invading company.
verses.before: You will rise like a storm; you will come like a cloud to cover the land—you and all your troops, and many peoples with you.
verses.after: You will advance like a storm, covering the land like a cloud—you, all your troops, and the many peoples with you.
verses.tsw_comparator: You will rise like a storm; you will come like a cloud to cover the land—you and all your troops, and many peoples with you.

verses.rationale: Preserves inward planning and moral judgment.
verses.before: “Thus says the LORD GOD: On that day, thoughts will arise in your heart, and you will devise an evil plan.
verses.after: “This is what the Lord GOD says: On that day thoughts will rise in your heart, and you will devise an evil plan.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Thus says the LORD GOD: On that day, thoughts will arise in your heart, and you will devise an evil plan.

verses.rationale: Keeps quoted opportunism and three absent defenses.
verses.before: You will say, ‘I will go up against a land of unwalled villages. I will come against those at rest, living securely—all of them living without walls, and having neither bars nor gates—
verses.after: You will say, ‘I will go up against a land of unwalled villages. I will attack people at peace, living securely, all without walls, bars, or gates,’
verses.tsw_comparator: You will say, ‘I will go up against a land of unwalled villages. I will come against those at rest, living securely—all of them living without walls, and having neither bars nor gates—

verses.rationale: Preserves navel image and rebuilding context.
verses.before: to seize plunder and take spoil, to turn your hand against inhabited ruins and against a people gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and possessions, who live at the center of the earth.’
verses.after: to seize spoil and take plunder, turning your hand against ruins now inhabited and a people gathered from the nations, acquiring livestock and property, living at the navel of the earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: to seize plunder and take spoil, to turn your hand against inhabited ruins and against a people gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and possessions, who live at the center of the earth.’

verses.rationale: Keeps young-lions image and repeated acquisitive questions.
verses.before: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will say to you, ‘Have you come to seize plunder? Have you assembled your company to take spoil, to carry away silver and gold, to take livestock and possessions, to seize great plunder?’
verses.after: Sheba, Dedan, the merchants of Tarshish, and all its young lions will ask you, ‘Have you come to seize spoil? Have you gathered your company to take plunder, carry off silver and gold, take livestock and property, and seize great spoil?’
verses.tsw_comparator: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will say to you, ‘Have you come to seize plunder? Have you assembled your company to take spoil, to carry away silver and gold, to take livestock and possessions, to seize great plunder?’

verses.rationale: Follows pinned know rather than an advance variant.
verses.before: “Therefore prophesy, mortal, and say to Gog: Thus says the LORD GOD: On that day, when my people Israel are living securely, will you not know it?
verses.after: “Therefore prophesy, son of man. Tell Gog: This is what the Lord GOD says: On that day, when my people Israel live securely, will you not know it?
verses.tsw_comparator: “Therefore prophesy, mortal, and say to Gog: Thus says the LORD GOD: On that day, when my people Israel are living securely, will you not know it?

verses.rationale: Keeps ancient cavalry and northern origin.
verses.before: You will come from your place, from the farthest parts of the north—you and many peoples with you, all of them riding horses, a great assembly and a mighty army.
verses.after: You will come from your place in the far north, you and many peoples with you, all riding horses, a great assembly and a mighty army.
verses.tsw_comparator: You will come from your place, from the farthest parts of the north—you and many peoples with you, all of them riding horses, a great assembly and a mighty army.

verses.rationale: Retains divine initiative without excusing evil plan.
verses.before: You will rise against my people Israel like a cloud, to cover the land. In the latter days it will happen: I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I show myself holy through you before their eyes, Gog.
verses.after: You will advance against my people Israel like a cloud covering the land. In later days I will bring you against my land, so the nations may know me when I show myself holy through you before their eyes, Gog.
verses.tsw_comparator: You will rise against my people Israel like a cloud, to cover the land. In the latter days it will happen: I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I show myself holy through you before their eyes, Gog.

verses.rationale: Keeps question and unspecified earlier prophets.
verses.before: “Thus says the LORD GOD: Are you the one of whom I spoke in former days through my servants, the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?
verses.after: “This is what the Lord GOD says: Are you the one I spoke of in former days through my servants, the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?
verses.tsw_comparator: “Thus says the LORD GOD: Are you the one of whom I spoke in former days through my servants, the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?

verses.rationale: Retains divine bodily anger idiom without extra action.
verses.before: On that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel, declares the LORD GOD, my wrath will rise in my anger.
verses.after: On that day, when Gog comes against Israel’s soil, declares the Lord GOD, my fury will rise in my anger.
verses.tsw_comparator: On that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel, declares the LORD GOD, my wrath will rise in my anger.

verses.rationale: Keeps oath force and definite earthquake.
verses.before: For in my jealousy, in the fire of my fury, I have spoken: Surely on that day there will be a great shaking upon the land of Israel.
verses.after: In my jealousy, in my blazing wrath, I declare: On that day there will surely be a great earthquake on Israel’s soil.
verses.tsw_comparator: For in my jealousy, in the fire of my fury, I have spoken: Surely on that day there will be a great shaking upon the land of Israel.

verses.rationale: Preserves complete creature list and collapse sequence.
verses.before: The fish of the sea, the birds of the heavens, the wild animals of the field, every creeping thing that creeps upon the ground, and every human being upon the face of the ground will tremble before me. The mountains will be thrown down, the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.
verses.after: The fish of the sea, birds of the sky, beasts of the field, every creature that crawls on the ground, and every human being on the earth will tremble before me. Mountains will be torn down, cliffs will fall, and every wall will collapse to the ground.
verses.tsw_comparator: The fish of the sea, the birds of the heavens, the wild animals of the field, every creeping thing that creeps upon the ground, and every human being upon the face of the ground will tremble before me. The mountains will be thrown down, the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.

verses.rationale: Keeps mutual violence and divine summoning.
verses.before: I will summon a sword against him upon all my mountains, declares the LORD GOD. Every one’s sword will be against their brother.
verses.after: I will summon a sword against him on all my mountains, declares the Lord GOD. Every man’s sword will be against his brother.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will summon a sword against him upon all my mountains, declares the LORD GOD. Every one’s sword will be against their brother.

verses.rationale: Preserves all six forms of judgment and recipients.
verses.before: I will enter into judgment with him through pestilence and bloodshed. Torrential rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur I will rain down upon him, upon his troops, and upon the many peoples with him.
verses.after: I will bring judgment on him with pestilence and bloodshed. I will rain down torrential rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur on him, his troops, and the many peoples with him.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will enter into judgment with him through pestilence and bloodshed. Torrential rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur I will rain down upon him, upon his troops, and upon the many peoples with him.

verses.rationale: Keeps three divine self-disclosures and refrain.
verses.before: I will show myself great and holy, and make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
verses.after: I will show my greatness and holiness and make myself known before many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
verses.tsw_comparator: I will show myself great and holy, and make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’

verses.rationale: Retains address consistent with chapter38.
verses.before: As for you, human one, prophesy against Gog and say: Thus says the LORD GOD: Look, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
verses.after: “Son of man, prophesy against Gog. Say: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
verses.tsw_comparator: As for you, human one, prophesy against Gog and say: Thus says the LORD GOD: Look, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

verses.rationale: Uses provisional lead-on for rare verb, noted.
verses.before: I will turn you around and lead you on; I will bring you up from the far reaches of the north and bring you against the mountains of Israel.
verses.after: I will turn you around and lead you on, bringing you up from the far north onto Israel’s mountains.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will turn you around and lead you on; I will bring you up from the far reaches of the north and bring you against the mountains of Israel.

verses.rationale: Keeps left/right weapon placement.
verses.before: I will strike your bow from your left hand, and make your arrows fall from your right hand.
verses.after: I will strike your bow from your left hand and knock your arrows from your right.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will strike your bow from your left hand, and make your arrows fall from your right hand.

verses.rationale: Preserves full company and scavenger imagery.
verses.before: On the mountains of Israel you will fall—you and all your companies and the peoples who are with you. I will give you as food to birds of prey of every kind and to the wild animals of the field.
verses.after: You will fall on Israel’s mountains, you and all your troops and the peoples with you. I have given you as food to birds of prey of every kind and to the beasts of the field.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the mountains of Israel you will fall—you and all your companies and the peoples who are with you. I will give you as food to birds of prey of every kind and to the wild animals of the field.

verses.rationale: Keeps announced fall and speech guarantee.
verses.before: You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken, declares the LORD GOD.
verses.after: You will fall in the open country, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.tsw_comparator: You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken, declares the LORD GOD.

verses.rationale: Preserves judgment beyond invading army.
verses.before: I will send fire against Magog and against people who live securely in the coastlands; and they will know that I am the LORD.
verses.after: I will send fire on Magog and on those who live securely in the coastlands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will send fire against Magog and against those who live securely in the coastlands; and they will know that I am the LORD.

verses.rationale: Keeps name repetition and in-Israel wording.
verses.before: I will make my holy name known among my people Israel, and I will not let my holy name be profaned anymore. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
verses.after: I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I will no longer let my holy name be profaned, and the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will make my holy name known among my people Israel, and I will not let my holy name be profaned anymore. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.

verses.rationale: Retains arrival emphasis without calendar speculation.
verses.before: Look, it is coming, and it will happen, declares the LORD GOD. This is the day of which I have spoken.
verses.after: Look, it is coming; it will happen, declares the Lord GOD. This is the day I have spoken of.
verses.tsw_comparator: Look, it is coming, and it will happen, declares the LORD GOD. This is the day of which I have spoken.

verses.rationale: Preserves six weapon types and duration.
verses.before: Then people who live in the cities of Israel will go out, and they will make fires and burn the weapons—small shields and large shields, bows and arrows, hand clubs and spears. They will make fires with them for seven years.
verses.after: “The people of Israel’s cities will go out and burn the weapons for fuel—small and large shields, bows and arrows, clubs and spears. They will use them for fires for seven years.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then those who live in the cities of Israel will go out, and they will make fires and burn the weapons—small shields and large shields, bows and arrows, hand clubs and spears. They will make fires with them for seven years.

verses.rationale: Keeps doubled reversal and two wood sources.
verses.before: They will not carry wood from the field or cut it from the forests, for they will make fires with the weapons. They will plunder people who plundered them and loot people who looted them, declares the LORD GOD.
verses.after: They will not gather wood from the fields or cut it in the forests, because the weapons will fuel their fires. They will plunder those who plundered them and loot those who looted them, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.tsw_comparator: They will not carry wood from the field or cut it from the forests, for they will make fires with the weapons. They will plunder those who plundered them and loot those who looted them, declares the LORD GOD.

verses.rationale: Preserves traveler wordplay and burial name.
verses.before: On that day I will give Gog a place there for a grave in Israel: the valley of people who pass by, east of the sea. It will block people who pass by. There they will bury Gog and all his multitude, and they will call it the Valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.after: “On that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers east of the sea. It will block the travelers’ way. There they will bury Gog and all his multitude and call it the Valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.tsw_comparator: On that day I will give Gog a place there for a grave in Israel: the valley of those who pass by, east of the sea. It will block those who pass by. There they will bury Gog and all his multitude, and they will call it the Valley of Hamon-gog.

verses.rationale: Keeps months distinct from weapon-burning years.
verses.before: The house of Israel will bury them for seven months, in order to cleanse the land.
verses.after: The house of Israel will spend seven months burying them to cleanse the land.
verses.tsw_comparator: The house of Israel will bury them for seven months, in order to cleanse the land.

verses.rationale: Retains collective burial and divine glory.
verses.before: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day that I am glorified, declares the LORD GOD.
verses.after: All the people of the land will bury them. It will bring them renown on the day I display my glory, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.tsw_comparator: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day that I am glorified, declares the LORD GOD.

verses.rationale: Preserves difficult division of workers with note.
verses.before: They will set apart people continually to pass through the land and bury those still lying on the surface of the land, in order to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will search.
verses.after: They will appoint men for continuing work, traveling through the land and, with those passing through, burying those left on its surface to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will make a search.
verses.tsw_comparator: They will set apart people continually to pass through the land and bury those still lying on the surface of the land, in order to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will search.

verses.rationale: Keeps discovery-marker-burial sequence.
verses.before: As people who pass through the land go through it, when one sees a human bone, that person will set up a marker beside it, until the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.after: As the travelers pass through the land, anyone who sees a human bone will set up a marker beside it until the buriers bury it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.tsw_comparator: As those who pass through the land go through it, when one sees a human bone, that person will set up a marker beside it, until the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.

verses.rationale: Retains related city name and cleansing conclusion.
verses.before: And the name of a city will also be Hamonah. Thus they will cleanse the land.
verses.after: A city will also be named Hamonah. In this way they will cleanse the land.
verses.tsw_comparator: And the name of a city will also be Hamonah. Thus they will cleanse the land.

verses.rationale: Preserves shocking sacrificial invitation to scavengers.
verses.before: As for you, human one, thus says the LORD GOD: Say to birds of every kind and to all the wild animals of the field: Gather yourselves and come; assemble yourselves from all around for my sacrifice that I am sacrificing for you, a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel. You will eat flesh and drink blood.
verses.after: “Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: Tell every kind of bird and every beast of the field: Gather and come! Assemble from all around for the sacrifice I am preparing for you, a great sacrifice on Israel’s mountains. You will eat flesh and drink blood.
verses.tsw_comparator: As for you, human one, thus says the LORD GOD: Say to birds of every kind and to all the wild animals of the field: Gather yourselves and come; assemble yourselves from all around for my sacrifice that I am sacrificing for you, a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel. You will eat flesh and drink blood.

verses.rationale: Keeps human-animal metaphor and all animal types.
verses.before: You will eat the flesh of warriors and drink the blood of the leaders of the earth—rams, lambs, male goats, and bulls, all of them fattened animals of Bashan.
verses.after: You will eat the flesh of warriors and drink the blood of the earth’s princes—rams, lambs, male goats, and bulls, all fattened in Bashan.
verses.tsw_comparator: You will eat the flesh of warriors and drink the blood of the leaders of the earth—rams, lambs, male goats, and bulls, all of them fattened animals of Bashan.

verses.rationale: Retains saturation and drunkenness imagery.
verses.before: You will eat fat until you are full and drink blood until you are drunk from my sacrifice that I have sacrificed for you.
verses.after: At the sacrifice I prepare for you, you will eat fat until you are full and drink blood until you are drunk.
verses.tsw_comparator: You will eat fat until you are full and drink blood until you are drunk from my sacrifice that I have sacrificed for you.

verses.rationale: Renders collective chariot term as its human personnel.
verses.before: At my table you will be filled with horse and chariot, warrior and every soldier, declares the LORD GOD.
verses.after: At my table you will eat your fill of horses and charioteers, warriors and every fighting man, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.tsw_comparator: At my table you will be filled with horse and chariot, warrior and every soldier, declares the LORD GOD.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine hand and public judgment.
verses.before: I will set my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see my judgment that I have carried out and my hand that I have laid on them.
verses.after: “I will display my glory among the nations. All the nations will see the judgment I have carried out and the hand I have laid upon them.
verses.tsw_comparator: I will set my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see my judgment that I have carried out and my hand that I have laid on them.

verses.rationale: Retains continuing recognition.
verses.before: From that day onward, the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.
verses.after: From that day onward, the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.
verses.tsw_comparator: From that day onward, the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.

verses.rationale: Keeps stated cause, hidden face and absolute wording.
verses.before: And the nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile because of their iniquity, because they acted faithlessly against me. So I hid my face from them and gave them into the hand of their foes, and all of them fell by the sword.
verses.after: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile because of their guilt, because they were unfaithful to me. I hid my face from them and gave them into their enemies’ hands, and all of them fell by the sword.
verses.tsw_comparator: And the nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile because of their iniquity, because they acted faithlessly against me. So I hid my face from them and gave them into the hand of their foes, and all of them fell by the sword.

verses.rationale: Retains repeated hidden-face clause.
verses.before: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their transgressions, and I hid my face from them.
verses.after: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and rebellions, and I hid my face from them.
verses.tsw_comparator: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their transgressions, and I hid my face from them.

verses.rationale: Keeps compassion and name concern together.
verses.before: So, thus says the LORD GOD: Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob, and I will have compassion on the whole house of Israel; and I will be jealous for my holy name.
verses.after: “Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Now I will restore Jacob’s fortunes and have compassion on the whole house of Israel. I will be jealous for my holy name.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore, thus says the LORD GOD: Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob, and I will have compassion on the whole house of Israel; and I will be jealous for my holy name.

verses.rationale: Follows bear reading with forget alternative noted.
verses.before: They will bear their shame and all their faithlessness by which they acted faithlessly against me, when they live securely on their land with no one to make them afraid.
verses.after: They will bear their disgrace and all the unfaithfulness they showed me, when they live securely on their own soil with no one making them afraid,
verses.tsw_comparator: They will bear their shame and all their faithlessness by which they acted faithlessly against me, when they live securely on their land with no one to make them afraid.

verses.rationale: Keeps temporal continuation and visible holiness.
verses.before: When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from the lands of their enemies, I will show myself holy through them in the sight of many nations.
verses.after: when I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from their enemies’ lands, showing myself holy through them before many nations.
verses.tsw_comparator: When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from the lands of their enemies, I will show myself holy through them in the sight of many nations.

verses.rationale: Preserves divine agency in exile and complete return.
verses.before: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, when I sent them into exile among the nations and then gathered them onto their land; I will leave none of them there any longer.
verses.after: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, because I sent them into exile among the nations and gathered them to their own soil. I will leave none of them there.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, when I sent them into exile among the nations and then gathered them onto their land; I will leave none of them there any longer.

verses.rationale: Keeps face/spirit resolution without added identification.
verses.before: I will no longer hide my face from them, because I have poured out my spirit on the house of Israel, declares the LORD GOD.
verses.after: I will no longer hide my face from them, for I will have poured out my spirit on the house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.”
verses.tsw_comparator: I will no longer hide my face from them, because I have poured out my spirit on the house of Israel, declares the LORD GOD.

verses.rationale: Keeps all dating relations without selecting disputed festival.
verses.before: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month—in the fourteenth year after the city was struck down—on that very day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and he brought me there.
verses.after: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month, fourteen years after the city fell—on that very day—the hand of the LORD came upon me, and he brought me there.
verses.tsw_comparator: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month—in the fourteenth year after the city was struck down—on that very day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and he brought me there.

verses.rationale: Retains visionary likeness and south orientation.
verses.before: In visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel and set me down on a very high mountain. Upon it was something like the structure of a city, to the south.
verses.after: In visions of God he brought me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain. On its south side was something like a city’s buildings.
verses.tsw_comparator: In visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel and set me down on a very high mountain. Upon it was something like the structure of a city, to the south.

verses.rationale: Keeps bronze likeness and two measuring tools.
verses.before: He brought me there, and look: there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a linen cord and a measuring reed in his hand. He was standing in the gateway.
verses.after: He brought me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze. He stood in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring reed in his hand.
verses.tsw_comparator: He brought me there, and look: there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a linen cord and a measuring reed in his hand. He was standing in the gateway.

verses.rationale: Preserves three attentional commands and reporting purpose.
verses.before: The man said to me, “Human one, see with your eyes, hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I am showing you, for you were brought here so that I might show it to you. Tell the house of Israel everything that you see.”
verses.after: The man said to me, “Son of man, look with your eyes, listen with your ears, and pay attention to everything I show you. You were brought here so I could show it to you. Tell the house of Israel everything you see.”
verses.tsw_comparator: The man said to me, “Human one, see with your eyes, hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I am showing you, for you were brought here in order that I might show it to you. Tell the house of Israel everything that you see.”

verses.rationale: Keeps long-cubit definition and both wall measures.
verses.before: And look: there was a wall outside the temple all around. In the man’s hand was a measuring reed, six cubits long, each cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth. He measured the width of the structure: one reed; and its height: one reed.
verses.after: A wall surrounded the temple on the outside. The man’s measuring reed was six long cubits, each a cubit and a handbreadth. He measured the wall: one reed thick and one reed high.
verses.tsw_comparator: And look: there was a wall outside the temple all around. In the man’s hand was a measuring reed, six cubits long, each cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth. He measured the width of the structure: one reed; and its height: one reed.

verses.rationale: Retains repeated threshold measure; layout uncertain noted.
verses.before: Then he came to the gate facing east, went up its steps, and measured the threshold of the gate: one reed wide. The other threshold was one reed wide.
verses.after: He came to the east-facing gate, climbed its steps, and measured the gate’s threshold: one reed wide. The other threshold was also one reed wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he came to the gate facing east, went up its steps, and measured the threshold of the gate: one reed wide. The other threshold was one reed wide.

verses.rationale: Keeps rooms, gaps and inner threshold distinct.
verses.before: Each gate chamber was one reed long and one reed wide, and the space between the chambers was five cubits. The threshold of the gate beside the vestibule of the gate, toward the temple, was one reed.
verses.after: Each guardroom was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the guardrooms were five cubits. The threshold beside the gate’s vestibule, on the temple side, was one reed.
verses.tsw_comparator: Each gate chamber was one reed long and one reed wide, and the space between the chambers was five cubits. The threshold of the gate beside the vestibule of the gate, toward the temple, was one reed.

verses.rationale: Retains verse despite different following measurement.
verses.before: He measured the vestibule of the gate, toward the temple: one reed.
verses.after: He measured the gate’s vestibule on the temple side: one reed.
verses.tsw_comparator: He measured the vestibule of the gate, toward the temple: one reed.

verses.rationale: Preserves eight/two rather than harmonizing prior reed.
verses.before: Then he measured the vestibule of the gate: eight cubits; and its gateposts: two cubits. The vestibule of the gate was toward the temple.
verses.after: He measured the gate’s vestibule: eight cubits, with its jambs two cubits. The vestibule was on the temple side.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he measured the vestibule of the gate: eight cubits; and its gateposts: two cubits. The vestibule of the gate was toward the temple.

verses.rationale: Retains symmetrical counts and dimensions.
verses.before: The gate chambers of the east gate were three on this side and three on that side; the three had one measurement. The gateposts on this side and on that side had one measurement.
verses.after: The east gate had three guardrooms on each side, all three the same size. The jambs on both sides also had the same measurements.
verses.tsw_comparator: The gate chambers of the east gate were three on this side and three on that side; the three had one measurement. The gateposts on this side and on that side had one measurement.

verses.rationale: Keeps distinct ten/thirteen dimensions.
verses.before: He measured the width of the entrance to the gate: ten cubits; the length of the gate: thirteen cubits.
verses.after: He measured the gate opening: ten cubits wide. The gate passage was thirteen cubits long.
verses.tsw_comparator: He measured the width of the entrance to the gate: ten cubits; the length of the gate: thirteen cubits.

verses.rationale: Retains barrier and room measurements.
verses.before: There was a boundary in front of the chambers, one cubit on this side, and a boundary of one cubit on that side. Each chamber was six cubits on this side and six cubits on that side.
verses.after: A barrier one cubit wide stood before the guardrooms on each side. The guardrooms were six cubits on each side.
verses.tsw_comparator: There was a boundary in front of the chambers, one cubit on this side, and a boundary of one cubit on that side. Each chamber was six cubits on this side and six cubits on that side.

verses.rationale: Preserves roof-to-roof endpoints.
verses.before: He measured the gate from the roof of one chamber to the roof of the other: twenty-five cubits wide, entrance opposite entrance.
verses.after: He measured the gate from one guardroom’s roof to the opposite roof: twenty-five cubits across, doorway opposite doorway.
verses.tsw_comparator: He measured the gate from the roof of one chamber to the roof of the other: twenty-five cubits wide, entrance opposite entrance.

verses.rationale: Retains difficult sixty-cubit clause without emendation.
verses.before: He made the gateposts sixty cubits high, with the court extending to the gateposts all around the gate.
verses.after: He made the jambs sixty cubits, and the court surrounded the gate up to the jambs.
verses.tsw_comparator: He made the gateposts sixty cubits high, with the court extending to the gateposts all around the gate.

verses.rationale: Keeps measurement endpoints and read-form entrance.
verses.before: From the front of the entrance gate to the front of the inner vestibule of the gate was fifty cubits.
verses.after: From the front of the entrance gate to the front of the inner vestibule was fifty cubits.
verses.tsw_comparator: From the front of the entrance gate to the front of the inner vestibule of the gate was fifty cubits.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated inward windows and palm motif.
verses.before: There were recessed windows in the chambers and in their gateposts, facing inward, all around the gate; and likewise in the vestibules. Windows were all around, facing inward, and palm trees were on the gateposts.
verses.after: Recessed windows surrounded the guardrooms and their jambs, facing inward into the gate; the vestibules likewise had windows all around facing inward. Palm trees decorated the jambs.
verses.tsw_comparator: There were recessed windows in the chambers and in their gateposts, facing inward, all around the gate; and likewise in the vestibules. Windows were all around, facing inward, and palm trees were on the gateposts.

verses.rationale: Keeps thirty chambers and continuous pavement.
verses.before: Then he brought me into the outer court. Look: there were chambers and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty chambers faced the pavement.
verses.after: Then he brought me into the outer court. Chambers and a pavement ran around the court; thirty chambers stood along the pavement.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he brought me into the outer court. Look: there were chambers and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty chambers faced the pavement.

verses.rationale: Retains relational length and lower designation.
verses.before: The pavement ran alongside the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates; this was the lower pavement.
verses.after: The pavement flanked the gates and matched their length. This was the lower pavement.
verses.tsw_comparator: The pavement ran alongside the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates; this was the lower pavement.

verses.rationale: Keeps two directions and hundred-cubit interval.
verses.before: He measured the width from the front of the lower gate to the front of the inner court, outside: one hundred cubits, on the east and on the north.
verses.after: He measured from the front of the lower gate to the outside front of the inner court: a hundred cubits, on the east and the north.
verses.tsw_comparator: He measured the width from the front of the lower gate to the front of the inner court, outside: one hundred cubits, on the east and on the north.

verses.rationale: Preserves north gate's introduction.
verses.before: As for the gate of the outer court facing north, he measured its length and its width.
verses.after: He measured the length and width of the north-facing gate of the outer court.
verses.tsw_comparator: As for the gate of the outer court facing north, he measured its length and its width.

verses.rationale: Retains three-per-side and full dimensions.
verses.before: Its chambers, three on this side and three on that side; its gateposts and its vestibules were like the measurements of the first gate: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.after: Its guardrooms, three on each side, its jambs, and its vestibules matched the first gate: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: Its chambers, three on this side and three on that side; its gateposts and its vestibules were like the measurements of the first gate: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.rationale: Keeps seven steps and repeated features.
verses.before: Its windows, its vestibules, and its palm trees were like the measurements of the gate facing east. They went up to it by seven steps, and its vestibule was before them.
verses.after: Its windows, vestibules, and palm trees matched the east-facing gate. Seven steps led up to it, with its vestibules ahead of them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Its windows, its vestibules, and its palm trees were like the measurements of the gate facing east. They went up to it by seven steps, and its vestibule was before them.

verses.rationale: Preserves gate alignment and interval.
verses.before: There was a gate to the inner court opposite the north gate and the east gate. He measured from gate to gate: one hundred cubits.
verses.after: A gate to the inner court stood opposite the north gate, as on the east. He measured a hundred cubits from gate to gate.
verses.tsw_comparator: There was a gate to the inner court opposite the north gate and the east gate. He measured from gate to gate: one hundred cubits.

verses.rationale: Keeps new direction and matching structures.
verses.before: Then he led me south, and look: there was a gate facing south. He measured its gateposts and its vestibules according to these measurements.
verses.after: He led me south, where there was a south-facing gate. He measured its jambs and vestibules; they had the same dimensions.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he led me south, and look: there was a gate facing south. He measured its gateposts and its vestibules according to these measurements.

verses.rationale: Retains explicit repeated dimensions.
verses.before: It and its vestibules had windows all around, like those windows: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.after: The gate and its vestibules had windows all around like the others. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: It and its vestibules had windows all around, like those windows: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.rationale: Keeps seven and one-per-side palms.
verses.before: Seven steps led up to it, and its vestibules were before them. It had palm trees on its gateposts, one on this side and one on that side.
verses.after: Seven steps led up to it, and its vestibules were ahead of them. Palm trees decorated the jambs, one on either side.
verses.tsw_comparator: Seven steps led up to it, and its vestibules were before them. It had palm trees on its gateposts, one on this side and one on that side.

verses.rationale: Retains third repeated court interval.
verses.before: There was a gate to the inner court facing south. He measured from gate to gate toward the south: one hundred cubits.
verses.after: The inner court also had a south-facing gate. He measured a hundred cubits from gate to gate on the south.
verses.tsw_comparator: There was a gate to the inner court facing south. He measured from gate to gate toward the south: one hundred cubits.

verses.rationale: Distinguishes inner south gate from outer.
verses.before: Then he brought me into the inner court through the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements.
verses.after: He brought me into the inner court through the south gate. He measured this south gate; it had the same dimensions.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he brought me into the inner court through the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements.

verses.rationale: Keeps structural inventory and repeated size.
verses.before: Its chambers, its gateposts, and its vestibules were according to these measurements. It and its vestibules had windows all around: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.after: Its guardrooms, jambs, and vestibules had the same measurements. The gate and its vestibules had windows all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: Its chambers, its gateposts, and its vestibules were according to these measurements. It and its vestibules had windows all around: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.rationale: Retains difficult extra measurement, not deleted.
verses.before: There were vestibules all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.
verses.after: Vestibules all around were twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: There were vestibules all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

verses.rationale: Keeps eight inner steps versus seven outer.
verses.before: Its vestibule faced the outer court, palm trees were on its gateposts, and eight steps led up to it.
verses.after: Its vestibules faced the outer court. Palm trees decorated its jambs, and eight steps led up to it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Its vestibule faced the outer court, palm trees were on its gateposts, and eight steps led up to it.

verses.rationale: Preserves eastward movement.
verses.before: Then he brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements.
verses.after: He brought me into the inner court on the east and measured the gate. It had the same dimensions.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements.

verses.rationale: Retains whole repeated description.
verses.before: Its chambers, its gateposts, and its vestibules were according to these measurements. It and its vestibules had windows all around: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.after: Its guardrooms, jambs, and vestibules had the same measurements. The gate and its vestibules had windows all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: Its chambers, its gateposts, and its vestibules were according to these measurements. It and its vestibules had windows all around: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.rationale: Keeps direction, paired decoration and eight steps.
verses.before: Its vestibule faced the outer court. Palm trees were on its gateposts, on this side and on that side, and eight steps led up to it.
verses.after: Its vestibules faced the outer court. Palm trees decorated its jambs on both sides, and eight steps led up to it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Its vestibule faced the outer court. Palm trees were on its gateposts, on this side and on that side, and eight steps led up to it.

verses.rationale: Preserves northward movement and introductory measurement.
verses.before: Then he brought me to the north gate and measured it according to these measurements:
verses.after: He brought me to the north gate and measured it. It had the same dimensions:
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he brought me to the north gate and measured it according to these measurements:

verses.rationale: Retains complete architectural repetition.
verses.before: its chambers, its gateposts, its vestibules, and its windows all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.after: guardrooms, jambs, vestibules, and windows all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: its chambers, its gateposts, its vestibules, and its windows all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.rationale: Retains pinned jambs rather than harmonizing vestibules.
verses.before: Its gateposts faced the outer court. Palm trees were on its gateposts, on this side and on that side, and eight steps led up to it.
verses.after: Its jambs faced the outer court, with palm trees on the jambs on both sides. Eight steps led up to it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Its gateposts faced the outer court. Palm trees were on its gateposts, on this side and on that side, and eight steps led up to it.

verses.rationale: Keeps washing location and offering identity.
verses.before: There was a chamber with its entrance by the gateposts of the gates; there they washed the burnt offering.
verses.after: There was a chamber with its doorway beside the gate jambs. There they washed the burnt offering.
verses.tsw_comparator: There was a chamber with its entrance by the gateposts of the gates; there they washed the burnt offering.

verses.rationale: Preserves three offering categories and four tables.
verses.before: In the vestibule of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to slaughter the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering.
verses.after: Inside the gate’s vestibule were two tables on each side for slaughtering the burnt offering, sin offering, and guilt offering.
verses.tsw_comparator: In the vestibule of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to slaughter the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering.

verses.rationale: Keeps exterior pairs distinct from interior.
verses.before: On the outside, as one goes up to the entrance of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, by the vestibule of the gate, were two tables.
verses.after: Outside, beside the approach to the north gate’s entrance, were two tables. Two more stood on the other side beside the vestibule.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the outside, as one goes up to the entrance of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, by the vestibule of the gate, were two tables.

verses.rationale: Preserves total and distribution.
verses.before: Four tables on this side and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables on which they slaughtered.
verses.after: Four tables stood on each side of the gate, eight tables in all, for slaughtering the sacrifices.
verses.tsw_comparator: Four tables on this side and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables on which they slaughtered.

verses.rationale: Keeps four stone tables and fractional measurements.
verses.before: There were four tables for the burnt offering, made of cut stone, each person and a half cubits long, one and a half cubits wide, and one cubit high. On them they placed the implements with which they slaughtered the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
verses.after: There were also four tables of cut stone for the burnt offering, each a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. On them they laid the tools for slaughtering burnt offerings and other sacrifices.
verses.tsw_comparator: There were four tables for the burnt offering, made of cut stone, each one and a half cubits long, one and a half cubits wide, and one cubit high. On them they placed the implements with which they slaughtered the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

verses.rationale: Uses provisional hooks; alternative ledges noted.
verses.before: Double ledges, one handbreadth wide, were fixed all around inside. The flesh of the offering was to be placed on the tables.
verses.after: Hooks a handbreadth long were fixed all around inside, and the flesh of the offering lay on the tables.
verses.tsw_comparator: Double ledges, one handbreadth wide, were fixed all around inside. The flesh of the offering was to be placed on the tables.

verses.rationale: Retains pinned singers and east rather than harmonizing.
verses.before: Outside the inner gate were chambers for the singers, in the inner court: one beside the north gate, facing south; and one beside the east gate, facing north.
verses.after: Outside the inner gate, in the inner court, were chambers for singers beside the north gate, facing south. Another stood beside the east gate, facing north.
verses.tsw_comparator: Outside the inner gate were chambers for the singers, in the inner court: one beside the north gate, facing south; and one beside the east gate, facing north.

verses.rationale: Keeps southern chamber's assigned duty.
verses.before: He said to me, “This chamber facing south is for the priests who keep charge of the temple.
verses.after: He told me, “The chamber facing south is for the priests who keep charge of the temple.
verses.tsw_comparator: He said to me, “This chamber facing south is for the priests who keep charge of the temple.

verses.rationale: Preserves Zadokite distinction and altar duty.
verses.before: The chamber facing north is for the priests who keep charge of the altar. They are the sons of Zadok, those among the sons of Levi who draw near to the LORD to minister to him.”
verses.after: The chamber facing north is for the priests who keep charge of the altar. These are the descendants of Zadok, who among the Levites approach the LORD to serve him.”
verses.tsw_comparator: The chamber facing north is for the priests who keep charge of the altar. They are the sons of Zadok, those among the sons of Levi who draw near to the LORD to minister to him.”

verses.rationale: Keeps square dimensions and altar placement.
verses.before: He measured the court: one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was in front of the temple.
verses.after: He measured the court: a square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide. The altar stood in front of the temple.
verses.tsw_comparator: He measured the court: one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was in front of the temple.

verses.rationale: Retains five/three relationships with construction uncertainty noted.
verses.before: Then he brought me to the vestibule of the temple and measured the gatepost of the vestibule: five cubits on this side and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.
verses.after: He brought me to the temple’s vestibule and measured its jambs: five cubits on each side. The gate’s side walls were three cubits on each side.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he brought me to the vestibule of the temple and measured the gatepost of the vestibule: five cubits on this side and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.

verses.rationale: Retains pinned eleven and unspecified step count.
verses.before: The length of the vestibule was twenty cubits, and its width was eleven cubits. There were steps by which they went up to it, and pillars stood beside the gateposts, one on this side and one on that side.
verses.after: The vestibule was twenty cubits long and eleven cubits wide, with steps leading up to it. Pillars stood beside the jambs, one on each side.
verses.tsw_comparator: The length of the vestibule was twenty cubits, and its width was eleven cubits. There were steps by which they went up to it, and pillars stood beside the gateposts, one on this side and one on that side.

verses.rationale: Retains unexpected tent term rather than omitting it.
verses.before: He brought me into the temple hall and measured the pilasters: six cubits wide on this side and six cubits wide on that side—the width of the tent.
verses.after: He brought me to the main hall and measured its jambs: six cubits wide on each side, the width of the tent.
verses.tsw_comparator: He brought me into the temple hall and measured the pilasters: six cubits wide on this side and six cubits wide on that side—the width of the tent.

verses.rationale: Keeps opening and room measures distinct.
verses.before: The width of the doorway was ten cubits, and the sides of the doorway were five cubits on this side and five cubits on that side. He measured its length: forty cubits; and its width: twenty cubits.
verses.after: The entrance was ten cubits wide, with five cubits on each side. He measured the hall: forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: The width of the doorway was ten cubits, and the sides of the doorway were five cubits on this side and five cubits on that side. He measured its length: forty cubits; and its width: twenty cubits.

verses.rationale: Preserves man alone entering and difficult six/seven measures.
verses.before: Then he went inward and measured the pilaster of the doorway: two cubits. The doorway was six cubits, and the width of the doorway was seven cubits.
verses.after: Then he went inside and measured the entrance jamb: two cubits. The entrance was six cubits, and the width beside the entrance was seven cubits.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he went inward and measured the pilaster of the doorway: two cubits. The doorway was six cubits, and the width of the doorway was seven cubits.

verses.rationale: Keeps square inner room and explicit designation.
verses.before: He measured its length: twenty cubits; and its width: twenty cubits, before the temple hall. Then he said to me, “This is the most holy place.”
verses.after: He measured the room’s length and width: twenty cubits by twenty, beyond the main hall. He told me, “This is the Most Holy Place.”
verses.tsw_comparator: He measured its length: twenty cubits; and its width: twenty cubits, before the temple hall. Then he said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

verses.rationale: Retains wall thickness and chamber width.
verses.before: He measured the wall of the house: six cubits. The width of each side chamber was four cubits, all around the house, all around.
verses.after: He measured the temple wall: six cubits thick. The side chambers all around the temple were four cubits wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: He measured the wall of the house: six cubits. The width of each side chamber was four cubits, all around the house, all around.
