verses.after: With it, morning by morning, provide a grain offering: one-sixth of an ephah and one-third of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour. This is a grain offering to the LORD, a lasting statute, continually.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall provide with it a grain offering every morning: one-sixth of an ephah, with one-third of a hin of oil to moisten the choice flour. This is a grain offering to the LORD, a permanent statute, continually.

verses.rationale: Follows read-form they and full offering list.
verses.before: They will provide the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil every morning as a continual burnt offering.
verses.after: They must offer the lamb, grain offering, and oil morning by morning as a continual burnt offering.
verses.tsw_comparator: They shall provide the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil every morning as a continual burnt offering.

verses.rationale: Preserves male heirs and permanent gift.
verses.before: Thus says the LORD GOD: If the prince gives a gift to any of his children, it is his inheritance; it will belong to his children. It is their possession by inheritance.
verses.after: “This is what the Lord GOD says: If the prince gives a gift from his inheritance to one of his sons, it will belong to his sons as their inherited possession.
verses.tsw_comparator: Thus says the LORD GOD: If the prince gives a gift to any of his children, it is his inheritance; it shall belong to his children. It is their possession by inheritance.

verses.rationale: Keeps temporary servant gift distinct from heirs'.
verses.before: But if he gives a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, it will belong to that servant until the year of release; then it will return to the prince. Only his inheritance belonging to his children will remain theirs.
verses.after: But if he gives a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, it will belong to that servant until the year of release, then return to the prince. His inheritance belongs permanently to his sons.
verses.tsw_comparator: But if he gives a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, it shall belong to that servant until the year of release; then it shall return to the prince. Only his inheritance belonging to his children shall remain theirs.

verses.rationale: Preserves anti-dispossession rule and its purpose.
verses.before: The prince will not take any of the people's inheritance, driving them from their possession. He will give his children an inheritance from his own possession, so that none of my people may be scattered, each from their possession.
verses.after: The prince must not take any of the people’s inheritance, forcing them from their possessions. He must give his sons an inheritance from his own possession, so none of my people is scattered from their property.”
verses.tsw_comparator: The prince shall not take any of the people's inheritance, driving them from their possession. He shall give his children an inheritance from his own possession, so that none of my people may be scattered, each from their possession.

verses.rationale: Keeps route and western location across label.
verses.before: Then he brought me through the entrance beside the gate to the holy chambers for the priests, which faced north; and there was a place at the far end, toward the west.
verses.after: He brought me through the entrance beside the gate into the priests’ holy chambers facing north. At their far western end was a place
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he brought me through the entrance beside the gate to the holy chambers for the priests, which faced north; and there was a place at the far end, toward the west.

verses.rationale: Preserves three preparations and holiness restriction.
verses.before: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests will boil the guilt offering and the sin offering, and bake the grain offering, so that they do not bring them out into the outer court and thereby make the people holy.”
verses.after: where, he told me, “The priests will boil the guilt offering and sin offering and bake the grain offering, so they do not carry them into the outer court and transmit holiness to the people.”
verses.tsw_comparator: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the guilt offering and the sin offering, and bake the grain offering, so that they do not bring them out into the outer court and thereby make the people holy.”

verses.rationale: Keeps four nested courts.
verses.before: Then he brought me out into the outer court and led me past the four corners of the court. There was a court in each corner of the court, a court in each corner.
verses.after: He led me out into the outer court and around its four corners. In each corner was another court.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he brought me out into the outer court and led me past the four corners of the court. There was a court in each corner of the court, a court in each corner.

verses.rationale: Retains forty/thirty and uncertain enclosed term.
verses.before: In the four corners of the court were enclosed courts, forty long and thirty wide. The four were all the same size, enclosed at the corners.
verses.after: These four corner courts were enclosed, each forty long and thirty wide. All four had the same dimensions.
verses.tsw_comparator: In the four corners of the court were enclosed courts, forty long and thirty wide. The four were all the same size, enclosed at the corners.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated surrounding hearth arrangement.
verses.before: There was a row of masonry around them, around all four; and places for boiling were made beneath the rows all around.
verses.after: A row of masonry ran around each of the four, with cooking hearths built beneath the rows all around.
verses.tsw_comparator: There was a row of masonry around them, around all four; and places for boiling were made beneath the rows all around.

verses.rationale: Distinguishes people's kitchens from priestly chambers.
verses.before: He said to me, “These are the cooking places where the servants of the house will boil the sacrifices of the people.”
verses.after: He told me, “These are the kitchens where the temple’s servants will boil the people’s sacrifices.”
verses.tsw_comparator: He said to me, “These are the cooking places where the servants of the house shall boil the sacrifices of the people.”

verses.rationale: Keeps three directional relationships.
verses.before: He brought me back to the entrance of the house, and there—water was flowing out from beneath the threshold of the house toward the east, for the front of the house faced east. The water was flowing down from beneath the south side of the house, south of the altar.
verses.after: He brought me back to the temple entrance. Water was flowing east from beneath its threshold, for the temple faced east. The water flowed down from beneath the temple’s right side, south of the altar.
verses.tsw_comparator: He brought me back to the entrance of the house, and there—water was flowing out from beneath the threshold of the house toward the east, for the front of the house faced east. The water was flowing down from beneath the south side of the house, south of the altar.

verses.rationale: Preserves indirect route and small initial flow.
verses.before: He brought me out by way of the north gate and led me around outside to the outer gate that faces east. There—the water was trickling out from the south side.
verses.after: He led me out through the north gate and around outside to the outer gate facing east. Water was trickling from its right side.
verses.tsw_comparator: He brought me out by way of the north gate and led me around outside to the outer gate that faces east. There—the water was trickling out from the south side.

verses.rationale: Keeps first measured stage and depth.
verses.before: As the man went out eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured a thousand cubits and led me through the water—water up to the ankles.
verses.after: The man went east with a measuring cord in his hand. He measured a thousand cubits and led me through ankle-deep water.
verses.tsw_comparator: As the man went out eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured a thousand cubits and led me through the water—water up to the ankles.

verses.rationale: Preserves two separate stages.
verses.before: He measured another thousand and led me through the water—water up to the knees. He measured another thousand and led me through—water up to the waist.
verses.after: He measured another thousand and led me through knee-deep water. He measured another thousand and led me through waist-deep water.
verses.tsw_comparator: He measured another thousand and led me through the water—water up to the knees. He measured another thousand and led me through—water up to the waist.

verses.rationale: Keeps fourth stage and repeated inability.
verses.before: He measured another thousand: a river that I could not cross, for the water had risen—water deep enough to swim in, a river that could not be crossed.
verses.after: He measured another thousand. Now it was a river I could not cross, for the water had risen, deep enough to swim in, a river that could not be crossed.
verses.tsw_comparator: He measured another thousand: a river that I could not cross, for the water had risen—water deep enough to swim in, a river that could not be crossed.

verses.rationale: Retains observation question and return.
verses.before: He said to me, “Have you seen this, mortal?” Then he led me and brought me back to the bank of the river.
verses.after: He asked me, “Have you seen this, son of man?” Then he led me back to the riverbank.
verses.tsw_comparator: He said to me, “Have you seen this, mortal?” Then he led me and brought me back to the bank of the river.

verses.rationale: Keeps abundance and both banks.
verses.before: When I returned, there—on the bank of the river—were very many trees, on this side and on that side.
verses.after: When I returned, I saw very many trees along both banks of the river.
verses.tsw_comparator: When I returned, there—on the bank of the river—were very many trees, on this side and on that side.

verses.rationale: Retains healing word and geography without silently naming sea.
verses.before: He said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and go down into the Arabah. They enter the sea, the sea where the waters flow out, and the waters are healed.
verses.after: He told me, “This water flows into the eastern region and down into the Arabah. When it enters the sea, the sea’s waters are healed.
verses.tsw_comparator: He said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and go down into the Arabah. They enter the sea, the sea where the waters flow out, and the waters are healed.

verses.rationale: Preserves living/healing repetition and plural streams.
verses.before: “Every living creature that swarms wherever the streams go will live. There will be very many fish, because these waters go there and are healed. Everything will live wherever the river goes.
verses.after: Every living creature that swarms wherever the streams go will live. There will be very many fish, because this water comes there and heals the waters. Everything will live wherever the river goes.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Every living creature that swarms wherever the streams go will live. There will be very many fish, because these waters go there and are healed. Everything will live wherever the river goes.

verses.rationale: Keeps named range and species comparison.
verses.before: “Fishers will stand beside it, from En-gedi as far as En-eglaim. It will be a place for spreading nets. Its fish will be of many kinds, like the fish of the Great Sea—very many.
verses.after: Fishermen will stand along it. From En-gedi to En-eglaim there will be places for spreading nets. Its fish will be of many kinds, as numerous as the fish of the Great Sea.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Fishers will stand beside it, from En-gedi as far as En-eglaim. It will be a place for spreading nets. Its fish will be of many kinds, like the fish of the Great Sea—very many.

verses.rationale: Retains exception to healing.
verses.before: “But its swamps and marshes will not be healed; they are given over to salt.
verses.after: But its marshes and pools will not be healed; they will be left for salt.
verses.tsw_comparator: “But its swamps and marshes will not be healed; they are given over to salt.

verses.rationale: Keeps monthly fruit, sanctuary source and leaf purpose.
verses.before: “On both banks of the river every kind of food tree will grow. Its leaves will not wither, and its fruit will not fail. Every month it will bear first fruit, because its water flows from the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaves for healing.”
verses.after: Every kind of food tree will grow along both riverbanks. Their leaves will not wither, and their fruit will not fail. They will bear fresh fruit each month because their water comes from the sanctuary. Their fruit will be for food and their leaves for healing.”
verses.tsw_comparator: “On both banks of the river every kind of food tree will grow. Its leaves will not wither, and its fruit will not fail. Every month it will bear first fruit, because its water flows from the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaves for healing.”

verses.rationale: Preserves twelve with Joseph's plural portions explained.
verses.before: Thus says the LORD GOD: “This is the boundary by which you are to receive the land as an inheritance for the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph will have two portions.
verses.after: This is what the Lord GOD says: “These are the boundaries by which you must divide the land as an inheritance among Israel’s twelve tribes. Joseph will have two portions.
verses.tsw_comparator: Thus says the LORD GOD: “This is the boundary by which you are to receive the land as an inheritance for the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.

verses.rationale: Keeps equality and oath gesture.
verses.before: You will inherit it, each person like another, the land that I raised my hand to give to your ancestors; this land will fall to you as an inheritance.
verses.after: You must inherit equal shares. I raised my hand in an oath to give this land to your ancestors, and it will fall to you as an inheritance.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall inherit it, each one like another, the land that I raised my hand to give to your ancestors; this land shall fall to you as an inheritance.

verses.rationale: Retains geographic continuation across labels.
verses.before: “This is the boundary of the land on the north side: from the Great Sea by way of Hethlon, toward Lebo-hamath, Zedad,
verses.after: “This is the land’s boundary: on the north, from the Great Sea along the road to Hethlon, toward Zedad,
verses.tsw_comparator: “This is the boundary of the land on the north side: from the Great Sea by way of Hethlon, toward Lebo-hamath, Zedad,

verses.rationale: Keeps full place list and relational borders.
verses.before: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which lies between the boundary of Damascus and the boundary of Hamath, and Hazer-hattikon, which is toward the boundary of Hauran.
verses.after: Hamath, Berothah, and Sibraim, which lies between the territories of Damascus and Hamath, and Hazer-hatticon on the border of Hauran.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which lies between the boundary of Damascus and the boundary of Hamath, and Hazer-hattikon, which is toward the boundary of Hauran.

verses.rationale: Retains uncertain northern syntax without moving names.
verses.before: The boundary will run from the sea to Hazar-enan, along the boundary of Damascus, with the boundary of Hamath to the north. This is the north side.
verses.after: The boundary will run from the sea to Hazar-enon, along the northern border of Damascus, with Hamath’s territory to the north. This is the northern side.
verses.tsw_comparator: The boundary shall run from the sea to Hazar-enan, along the boundary of Damascus, with the boundary of Hamath to the north. This is the north side.

verses.rationale: Keeps pinned measure rather than Tamar variant.
verses.before: “The east side will run between Hauran and Damascus, between Gilead and the land of Israel, along the Jordan, from the northern boundary to the eastern sea. You will measure this as the east side.
verses.after: “On the east, between Hauran and Damascus, and between Gilead and Israel’s land, the Jordan forms the boundary. Measure from the boundary down to the eastern sea. This is the eastern side.
verses.tsw_comparator: “The east side shall run between Hauran and Damascus, between Gilead and the land of Israel, along the Jordan, from the northern boundary to the eastern sea. You shall measure this as the east side.

verses.rationale: Retains named water dispute and unnamed Wadi.
verses.before: “The south side, toward the south, will run from Tamar to the waters of Meriboth-kadesh, then along the wadi to the Great Sea. This is the south side toward the south.
verses.after: “On the south, the boundary runs from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, then along the Wadi to the Great Sea. This is the southern side.
verses.tsw_comparator: “The south side, toward the south, shall run from Tamar to the waters of Meriboth-kadesh, then along the wadi to the Great Sea. This is the south side toward the south.

verses.rationale: Keeps sea boundary and northern endpoint.
verses.before: “The west side will be the Great Sea, from the southern boundary to opposite Lebo-hamath. This is the west side.
verses.after: “On the west, the Great Sea is the boundary, up to a point opposite Lebo-hamath. This is the western side.
verses.tsw_comparator: “The west side shall be the Great Sea, from the southern boundary to opposite Lebo-hamath. This is the west side.

verses.rationale: Retains tribal distribution command.
verses.before: “You will divide this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.after: “Divide this land among yourselves according to Israel’s tribes.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall divide this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

verses.rationale: Preserves resident foreigners' inclusion and specified family condition.
verses.before: You will assign it by lot as an inheritance for yourselves and for the sojourners who reside among you and who have borne children among you. They will be to you as native-born Israelites; with you they will receive an inheritance by lot among the tribes of Israel.
verses.after: Allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the resident foreigners among you who have children among you. You must treat them like native-born Israelites; they will receive an inheritance with you among Israel’s tribes.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall assign it by lot as an inheritance for yourselves and for the sojourners who reside among you and who have borne children among you. They shall be to you as native-born Israelites; with you they shall receive an inheritance by lot among the tribes of Israel.

verses.rationale: Keeps local tribal inheritance entitlement.
verses.before: In whatever tribe the sojourner resides, there you will give that person an inheritance,” declares the LORD GOD.
verses.after: In whatever tribe a resident foreigner lives, there you must give that person an inheritance, declares the Lord GOD.”
verses.tsw_comparator: In whatever tribe the sojourner resides, there you shall give that person an inheritance,” declares the LORD GOD.

verses.rationale: Keeps first tribe, northern boundary and east-west span.
verses.before: These are the names of the tribes: From the northern end, beside the way of Hethlon toward Lebo-hamath, Hazar-enan—the border of Damascus northward, beside Hamath—Dan will have one portion, from the eastern side to the western side.
verses.after: “These are the tribes’ names. At the northern end, along the road to Hethlon, Lebo-hamath, and Hazar-enan on Damascus’s northern border beside Hamath, Dan will have one portion, extending from east to west.
verses.tsw_comparator: These are the names of the tribes: From the northern end, beside the way of Hethlon toward Lebo-hamath, Hazar-enan—the border of Damascus northward, beside Hamath—Dan shall have one portion, from the eastern side to the western side.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated allotment formula and sequence.
verses.before: Along the border of Dan, from the eastern side to the western side: Asher, one portion.
verses.after: Along Dan’s boundary, from east to west: Asher, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Dan, from the eastern side to the western side: Asher, one portion.

verses.rationale: Keeps Naphtali immediately after Asher.
verses.before: Along the border of Asher, from the eastern side to the western side: Naphtali, one portion.
verses.after: Along Asher’s boundary, from east to west: Naphtali, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Asher, from the eastern side to the western side: Naphtali, one portion.

verses.rationale: Preserves Manasseh's position.
verses.before: Along the border of Naphtali, from the eastern side to the western side: Manasseh, one portion.
verses.after: Along Naphtali’s boundary, from east to west: Manasseh, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Naphtali, from the eastern side to the western side: Manasseh, one portion.

verses.rationale: Keeps Joseph's second tribal allotment distinct.
verses.before: Along the border of Manasseh, from the eastern side to the western side: Ephraim, one portion.
verses.after: Along Manasseh’s boundary, from east to west: Ephraim, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Manasseh, from the eastern side to the western side: Ephraim, one portion.

verses.rationale: Preserves Reuben's place in order.
verses.before: Along the border of Ephraim, from the eastern side to the western side: Reuben, one portion.
verses.after: Along Ephraim’s boundary, from east to west: Reuben, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Ephraim, from the eastern side to the western side: Reuben, one portion.

verses.rationale: Keeps Judah next to sacred strip.
verses.before: Along the border of Reuben, from the eastern side to the western side: Judah, one portion.
verses.after: Along Reuben’s boundary, from east to west: Judah, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Reuben, from the eastern side to the western side: Judah, one portion.

verses.rationale: Retains strip width and internal sanctuary.
verses.before: Along the border of Judah, from the eastern side to the western side, will be the contribution that you set apart: twenty-five thousand wide and as long as one of the portions, from the eastern side to the western side. The sanctuary will be in its midst.
verses.after: “Along Judah’s boundary, from east to west, will be the contribution you set apart: twenty-five thousand wide, as long as one tribal portion from east to west. The sanctuary will be within it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Judah, from the eastern side to the western side, shall be the contribution that you set apart: twenty-five thousand wide and as long as one of the portions, from the eastern side to the western side. The sanctuary shall be in its midst.

verses.rationale: Keeps sacred portion dimensions distinct from full strip.
verses.before: The contribution that you set apart for the LORD will be twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand wide.
verses.after: The contribution you set apart for the LORD will be twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: The contribution that you set apart for the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand wide.

verses.rationale: Preserves all four directional dimensions.
verses.before: This holy contribution will belong to the priests: twenty-five thousand northward, ten thousand wide westward, ten thousand wide eastward, and twenty-five thousand long southward. The sanctuary of the LORD will be in its midst.
verses.after: This holy contribution will belong to the priests: twenty-five thousand on the north, ten thousand wide on the west, ten thousand wide on the east, and twenty-five thousand long on the south. The LORD’s sanctuary will be within it.
verses.tsw_comparator: This holy contribution shall belong to the priests: twenty-five thousand northward, ten thousand wide westward, ten thousand wide eastward, and twenty-five thousand long southward. The sanctuary of the LORD shall be in its midst.

verses.rationale: Keeps lineage and contrast of conduct.
verses.before: It will be for the consecrated priests, the descendants of Zadok, who kept my charge and did not go astray when the people of Israel went astray, as the Levites did.
verses.after: It is for the consecrated priests descended from Zadok, who kept my charge and did not stray when the Israelites strayed as the Levites did.
verses.tsw_comparator: It shall be for the consecrated priests, the descendants of Zadok, who kept my charge and did not go astray when the people of Israel went astray, as the Levites did.

verses.rationale: Retains most-holy status and adjacent Levites.
verses.before: It will be for them a contribution from the contribution of the land, most holy, beside the border of the Levites.
verses.after: It will be their special contribution from the land’s contribution, a most holy portion beside the Levites’ boundary.
verses.tsw_comparator: It shall be for them a contribution from the contribution of the land, most holy, beside the border of the Levites.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated dimensions rather than compressing.
verses.before: The Levites will have, alongside the territory of the priests, twenty-five thousand in length and ten thousand in width. The whole length will be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.
verses.after: “Alongside the priests’ territory, the Levites will have twenty-five thousand in length and ten thousand in width. Its full length will be twenty-five thousand and its width ten thousand.
verses.tsw_comparator: The Levites shall have, alongside the territory of the priests, twenty-five thousand in length and ten thousand in width. The whole length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

verses.rationale: Keeps three restrictions and holy rationale.
verses.before: They will not sell any of it, exchange it, or transfer this choice portion of the land, for it is holy to the LORD.
verses.after: They must not sell or exchange any of it, nor transfer this choice land to others, because it is holy to the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: They shall not sell any of it, exchange it, or transfer this choice portion of the land, for it is holy to the LORD.

verses.rationale: Preserves common versus holy distinction.
verses.before: The remaining five thousand in width alongside the twenty-five thousand will be common land for the city, for dwellings and open land. The city will be in its midst.
verses.after: “The remaining strip, five thousand wide and twenty-five thousand long, will be common land for the city, for houses and open land. The city will stand in its center.
verses.tsw_comparator: The remaining five thousand in width alongside the twenty-five thousand shall be common land for the city, for dwellings and open land. The city shall be in its midst.

verses.rationale: Follows read omission of duplicated five; preserves four sides.
verses.before: These will be its measurements: the north side, four thousand five hundred; the south side, four thousand five hundred; the east side, four thousand five hundred; and the west side, four thousand five hundred.
verses.after: These are the city’s dimensions: four thousand five hundred on the north, four thousand five hundred on the south, four thousand five hundred on the east, and four thousand five hundred on the west.
verses.tsw_comparator: These shall be its measurements: the north side, four thousand five hundred; the south side, four thousand five hundred; the east side, four thousand five hundred; and the west side, four thousand five hundred.

verses.rationale: Keeps four explicit margins.
verses.before: The city will have open land: two hundred fifty northward, two hundred fifty southward, two hundred fifty eastward, and two hundred fifty westward.
verses.after: The city’s open land will extend two hundred fifty to the north, two hundred fifty to the south, two hundred fifty to the east, and two hundred fifty to the west.
verses.tsw_comparator: The city shall have open land: two hundred fifty northward, two hundred fifty southward, two hundred fifty eastward, and two hundred fifty westward.

verses.rationale: Preserves paired agricultural strips and purpose.
verses.before: What remains in length alongside the holy contribution will be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward, alongside the holy contribution. Its produce will be food for people who serve the city.
verses.after: The remaining length beside the holy contribution will be ten thousand to the east and ten thousand to the west, alongside the holy contribution. Its produce will provide food for the city’s workers.
verses.tsw_comparator: What remains in length alongside the holy contribution shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward, alongside the holy contribution. Its produce shall be food for those who serve the city.

verses.rationale: Keeps all-tribes participation.
verses.before: People who serve the city will cultivate it from all the tribes of Israel.
verses.after: The city’s workers from all Israel’s tribes will cultivate it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those who serve the city shall cultivate it from all the tribes of Israel.

verses.rationale: Preserves complete square including common city portion.
verses.before: The whole contribution will be twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You will set apart the holy contribution as a square, together with the property of the city.
verses.after: The entire contribution will be twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. Set apart this square as the holy contribution together with the city’s possession.
verses.tsw_comparator: The whole contribution shall be twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall set apart the holy contribution as a square, together with the property of the city.

verses.rationale: Keeps long boundary description and central holy area.
verses.before: What remains will belong to the prince, on both sides of the holy contribution and of the property of the city: alongside the twenty-five thousand of the contribution, to the eastern border; and westward alongside the twenty-five thousand, to the western border, corresponding to the portions. It will belong to the prince. The holy contribution and the sanctuary of the house will be in its midst.
verses.after: “What remains on either side of the holy contribution and the city’s possession belongs to the prince. From the contribution’s twenty-five-thousand length to the eastern boundary, and westward from its twenty-five-thousand length to the western boundary, alongside the tribal portions, it belongs to the prince. The holy contribution and the temple sanctuary will be within it.
verses.tsw_comparator: What remains shall belong to the prince, on both sides of the holy contribution and of the property of the city: alongside the twenty-five thousand of the contribution, to the eastern border; and westward alongside the twenty-five thousand, to the western border, corresponding to the portions. It shall belong to the prince. The holy contribution and the sanctuary of the house shall be in its midst.

verses.rationale: Keeps exclusions located within ruler's broader strip.
verses.before: From the property of the Levites and from the property of the city, which are among what belongs to the prince, everything between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin will belong to the prince.
verses.after: The Levites’ possession and the city’s possession will lie within the prince’s land. The land between Judah’s boundary and Benjamin’s boundary will belong to the prince.
verses.tsw_comparator: From the property of the Levites and from the property of the city, which are in the midst of what belongs to the prince, everything between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin shall belong to the prince.

verses.rationale: Marks southern allotments beginning with Benjamin.
verses.before: As for the rest of the tribes: from the eastern side to the western side, Benjamin, one portion.
verses.after: “For the remaining tribes, from east to west: Benjamin, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: As for the rest of the tribes: from the eastern side to the western side, Benjamin, one portion.

verses.rationale: Preserves Simeon's position.
verses.before: Along the border of Benjamin, from the eastern side to the western side: Simeon, one portion.
verses.after: Along Benjamin’s boundary, from east to west: Simeon, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Benjamin, from the eastern side to the western side: Simeon, one portion.

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated formula and Issachar.
verses.before: Along the border of Simeon, from the eastern side to the western side: Issachar, one portion.
verses.after: Along Simeon’s boundary, from east to west: Issachar, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Simeon, from the eastern side to the western side: Issachar, one portion.

verses.rationale: Preserves Zebulun next to Gad.
verses.before: Along the border of Issachar, from the eastern side to the western side: Zebulun, one portion.
verses.after: Along Issachar’s boundary, from east to west: Zebulun, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Issachar, from the eastern side to the western side: Zebulun, one portion.

verses.rationale: Keeps final tribe and span.
verses.before: Along the border of Zebulun, from the eastern side to the western side: Gad, one portion.
verses.after: Along Zebulun’s boundary, from east to west: Gad, one portion.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Zebulun, from the eastern side to the western side: Gad, one portion.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated southern boundary.
verses.before: Along the border of Gad, on the south side, the boundary will run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, then along the wadi to the Great Sea.
verses.after: Along Gad’s boundary on the south, the border runs from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, then along the Wadi to the Great Sea.
verses.tsw_comparator: Along the border of Gad, on the south side, the boundary shall run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, then along the wadi to the Great Sea.

verses.rationale: Keeps concluding allotment declaration.
verses.before: This is the land that you will allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these are their portions, declares the LORD GOD.
verses.after: This is the land you must allot as an inheritance to Israel’s tribes, and these are their portions, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.tsw_comparator: This is the land that you shall allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these are their portions, declares the LORD GOD.

verses.rationale: Introduces gates with side measurement.
verses.before: These are the exits of the city: On the north side, four thousand five hundred in measurement,
verses.after: “These are the city’s exits. The north side measures four thousand five hundred.
verses.tsw_comparator: These are the exits of the city: On the north side, four thousand five hundred in measurement,

verses.rationale: Preserves Levi among gates though no tribal strip.
verses.before: there will be three gates of the city, named for the tribes of Israel: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.
verses.after: The city’s gates will bear the names of Israel’s tribes. Three gates will face north: one for Reuben, one for Judah, and one for Levi.
verses.tsw_comparator: there shall be three gates of the city, named for the tribes of Israel: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.

verses.rationale: Keeps Joseph as single gate name.
verses.before: On the east side, four thousand five hundred, with three gates: the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.
verses.after: The east side measures four thousand five hundred, with three gates: one for Joseph, one for Benjamin, and one for Dan.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the east side, four thousand five hundred, with three gates: the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.

verses.rationale: Preserves southern gate order.
verses.before: On the south side, four thousand five hundred in measurement, with three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.
verses.after: The south side measures four thousand five hundred, with three gates: one for Simeon, one for Issachar, and one for Zebulun.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the south side, four thousand five hundred in measurement, with three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.

verses.rationale: Keeps western gate order.
verses.before: On the west side, four thousand five hundred, with three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.
verses.after: The west side measures four thousand five hundred, with three gates: one for Gad, one for Asher, and one for Naphtali.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the west side, four thousand five hundred, with three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.

verses.rationale: Preserves perimeter and climactic presence name.
verses.before: The perimeter will be eighteen thousand. And the name of the city from that day will be: **The LORD Is There.**
verses.after: The distance all around is eighteen thousand. From that day the city’s name will be ‘The LORD Is There.’”
verses.tsw_comparator: The perimeter shall be eighteen thousand. And the name of the city from that day shall be: **The LORD Is There.**

comparative_references.scope: All 654 TSW verses bound and compared programmatically after independent drafting from each selected original-language record and all annotations. Selected differences read during focused authoring checks. Overlap is triage only.
